purpose: Independent mechanical acceptance for native 3D exercise replacements; numerical checks remain separate from visual and physical-device evidence.

definitions.angles: Flexion degrees use 0 = straight elbow/knee. Numeric ranges below are conservative authoring targets, not source-claimed measured clinical standards or individual exercise prescriptions.
definitions.contact: For each frame measure actual world-space hand/foot surfaces against equipment/support. Validate both numeric motion and visible loop; names, one pose, skeleton-only tests and passed builds do not establish correct exercise.
definitions.holds: Plate pinch, Spanish squat, Nordic hold and dead hang are ISOMETRIC. No repeated lifting/squatting/lowering/pull-ups. A loop may keep the pose and vary a subtle breathing or target-muscle shading cue.

commonAcceptance: Same body/equipment/camera/lighting remain consistent frame-to-frame, no pose interpolation from unrelated stills.
Named target muscle IDs highlighted red; resting muscles gray; no posterior triceps labelled as anterior biceps.
No flipped joints, bone-length change, object teleportation, hand losing grip or cable cutting through head/forearm.
Head/limbs/equipment remain inside 512px canvas at all frames; target and relevant contact point visible at app thumbnail size.
Any footprint moves relative to treadmill/stepmill only as equipment physically requires. Ground-camera tracking may move environmental markers but stance foot must share ground velocity.
Release/last-first seam does not jump stance, props or body; review rendered frames at start,quarter,half,threequarter plus actual encoded loop.

exercises.identity: User-confirmed standing LOW-rear-pulley overhead triceps extension with upright torso and short curved EZ cable attachment.

primarySources.scope: Primary low-pulley/upright/forearm-only mechanics guide. Its example uses a straight bar; attachment shape is NOT copied. User explicitly confirmed the short curved EZ attachment and standing upright low-pulley variant.

fixed: Feet in planted split stance; knees softly bent.
Torso erect; measured shoulder-center to hip-center direction within 5 degrees of vertical for the whole repetition.
Actual humerus vectors point vertically up beside the ears and remain fixed; shoulders and elbows do not swing.
Actual equipment pulley anchor stays low and behind at Y=0.14 metres; its source metadata must agree with the exported equipment anchor.
Wrists retain the two angled grip sections of one short cable EZ bar; actual grip-center separation drifts no more than 0.5 mm through all 49 poses.
moves: Only forearms move at the elbows: short EZ bar moves from behind the head to overhead.

Authored controlled elbow flexion follows 105 degrees at start to 12 degrees at full extension, then returns to 105 degrees. These are illustrative animation targets, not source-claimed clinical prescriptions.
Cable stays taut from centered EZ-bar carabiner to the LOW pulley behind the athlete.
Only weight-stack vertical travel follows cable length.
reject: High pulley or high/hinged forward-extension mechanics substituted for the user-confirmed low-pulley upright variant.
Forward torso hinge or lumbar arch replacing controlled elbow extension.
Rope/straight/V-pushdown attachment instead of short curved EZ bar.
Upper arms down beside torso like pushdown, or sweeping shoulders like an overhead press.
Cable passes through head/upper arm, detaches from bar, or metadata labels a different source/anchor variant.

exercises.identity: Dedicated hip-thrust/glute-drive machine, not Smith or barbell.

primarySources.scope: Manufacturer page18: feet fixed pedalplate; upperback supported; extend until torso and thighs form line.
Purpose-built machine, waist restraint, back pads and non-slip foot platform.

fixed: Both feet flat on platform, no stance slide.
Fixed machine frame and lever pivot.
Upperback/shoulder region stays in contact with back pad; torso may rotate around this supported region.
Hands stay on fixed side handles if shown.
moves: Pelvis extends upward/back along consistent arc from hip-flexed bottom to near-neutral hip at top.
Hip restraint/pad stays across hip crease and follows pelvis, not hovering.
Moving lever and its plates rotate about one fixed machine pivot, do not translate off-frame.
Knees naturally follow fixed-foot geometry; spine remains neutral.
reject: stationary pelvis with torso crunching only

exercises.identity: Standing heel raise with knee held flexed. Existing routine has per-side context; preserve unilateral rendering unless user confirms bilateral.

primarySources.scope: Original clinician demo: slightly unlocked knees, lift heels, support optional.
Publisher explains bent-knee rise onto toes and controlled return; source platform is not to be copied.

fixed: Working forefoot/toe contact planted on level ground.
Working knee remains visibly bent throughout, not straightening to rise.
Support hand fixed if a rail shown.
In unilateral version free foot remains clear throughout.
moves: Ankle plantarflexes, heel rises, then heel lowers; knee/hip translate in the amount required by the toe pivot.
No knee-extension squat action.
reject: toe lift/dorsiflexion instead of heel lift

exercises.identity: Unloaded level-ground alternating walking, not treadmill, incline, marching or lunges.

primarySources.scope: Primary gait service context; numeric animation targets here are author choices, not quotations from this overview.
Potential CC0 Mesh2Motion Walk motion source; still must review resulting rendered gait and license at upstream.

fixed: Level continuous ground plane.
Head/torso upright with modest natural bob; no loaded object.
During stance, planted foot shares ground world velocity; track-camera environmental motion allowed.
moves: Alternating heel contact, loading/midstance, push-off, swing clearance and return.
Opposite arm/leg swing, continuous left-right gait, no both-feet flight phase.
reject: same-side arms and legs swing in phase
exaggerated marching knees or stair-step trajectory
one leg remains planted all cycle

exercises.identity: Continuous alternating walking on revolving stairs; generic original gray machine.

primarySources.scope: Manufacturer StepMill shows moving tread mechanism,6inch stepheight and footprint.

fixed: Machine frame, console, handrails stationary.
Hands if shown stay lightly on rail grips, not carrying all bodyweight.
Torso/head remain upright in approximately one world location over the machine.
moves: Treads descend backward/down at constant speed, circulate hidden under casing.
Stance sole stays attached to same descending tread without visible slip.
Swing foot clears riser and lands on next higher tread; opposite foot then switches.
Foot motions alternate every step; knees/hips extend to raise body relative tread while body position stays centered.
reject: same tread resets visibly under loaded foot
treadmill belt or highbox step-up substitute

exercises.identity: Single-arm supinated low-cable curl facing away from rear pulley.

primarySources.scope: Exercise originator; elbow near side, mild forward bow at curl contraction and controlled lean back on lowering; avoid forearm-cable contact.

fixed: Feet/split stance fixed.
Pulley fixed low behind athlete.
Upper arm/elbow stays near side; slight natural shoulder extension, not dragged far backward.
moves: Elbow curls single D-handle toward shoulder under supinated grip.
Mild controlled forward torso inclination may accompany curl (original method), not a swinging cheat.
Cable remains taut and clear of forearm.
reject: triceps colored instead of anterior biceps
humerus swings forward into front raise
cable aligned with forearm at top or through forearm

exercises.identity: Half kneeling side-on, working arm FAR from tower crosses body toward high pulley.

primarySources.scope: Live Lean TV original trainer demonstration and instructions.

fixed: Near knee grounded on pad; far foot forward.
Pelvis and torso square once set side-on; avoid twisting through repetition.
Free hand rests naturally; pulley fixed just above head when kneeling.
moves: Far arm reaches UP and ACROSS body toward opposite-side pulley.
Sweep upper arm down and around with elbow bending, hand toward working-side hip.
Controlled return to same crossbody stretched reach.
reject: NEAR arm does ordinary ipsilateral pulldown
both knees on floor when original variation halfkneeling

exercises.identity: Supported captain chair bent-knee raise, not hanging from overhead bar.

primarySources.scope: Primary ACE exercise instruction: hold handles, back against pad, legs dangling, knees toward chest and controlled return.
Manufacturer elbow/forearm pads, grips and back pad.

fixed: Forearms on elbow pads, hands gripping forward handles.
Back supported against back pad; upper torso nearly fixed.
Machine frame fixed; both feet clear floor/frame.
moves: Both hips flex together; knees bend together toward chest; mild posterior pelvic curl at top.
Controlled lowering to dangling legs; no swinging.
reject: one knee rises while other remains down

exercises.identity: Two-hand isometric bar hang, arms long and feet free.

primarySources.scope: APC Physio original demonstration: comfortable grip,armsstraight,feetfree,hold.
Professional exercise org on grip and shoulder control; no invented repetitions.

fixed: Both hands grip same fixed overhead bar throughout.
Arms extended without repeated elbow flexion.
Feet clear floor; body long and stable.
Shoulders stay in selected controlled hanging posture.
moves: Isometric hold only; optional tiny breathing/visual target cue.

exercises.identity: Static pinch grip of smooth plate faces, not center-hole or handle grip.

primarySources.scope: Primary grip-sport documentation shows smooth plates facing out and thumb/fingers opposition.

fixed: Torso upright, feet planted.
One hand at side pinches two adjacent plate faces near top edge; thumb opposed to fingers.
Plates hang clear ground and thigh; hand/plates stationary throughout.
No curling elbow or shrugging.
moves: Isometric hold only.

exercises.identity: Static Spanish squat with taut support band behind knees anchored in FRONT.

primarySources.scope: Coach demonstration: front rackanchor, bandbackknees, nearverticalshins/trunk,about90degree knee,isometricoption.

fixed: Feet flat fixed at shoulderwidth.
Both knees flexed about right angle, shins nearvertical.
Torso nearvertical; hips sit back.
Band runs from front fixed anchor around BACKS of both knees; remains taut.
Arms at chest/forward stable.
moves: Isometric hold only; no repeated squat up/down.

exercises.identity: Static forward-lean Nordic hold, ankles secured and knee-hip-shoulder line straight.

primarySources.scope: Manufacturer clinician author distinguishes isometric from dynamic Nordic; angle chosen within control, no universal correct angle.

fixed: Both knees rest paddedfloor; ankles held securely by fixed padded support.
Knees,hips,shoulders form nearstraight line.
Forward lean held at chosen angle; hips do NOT fold.
Hands ready for support but not pressing floor in the held pose.
moves: Isometric hold only; stable kneeangle, no progressive lowering.

exercises.identity: Level walking with ONE dumbbell at one side, tall torso resisting lateral bend.

primarySources.scope: ACE original instruction:one dumbbell beside hip,backstraight,walk,then switcharms.

fixed: Loaded hand stays gripping dumbbell at side, elbow long.
Dumbbell follows hand, no independent drift.
Torso upright with shoulderline nearlevel.
moves: Alternating levelgait with stance-ground coupling like Walking.
Free arm may swing; loaded arm has small natural sway only.
reject: dumbbell swinging into leg or floor
